design_principle: Infrastructure registers physical truth without replacing operational identities. Site placement, containment, Cloud assignment, descriptive IPs, reusable compatibility knowledge, installed Component history and workbook evidence remain independent relationship authorities; none may silently imply connectivity, identity equality or another domain lifecycle fact.
